newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish inflation trend very good - Ferrer.
newsitem.headline: Spanish inflation trend very good - Ferrer.

text.p: The trend in Spanish inflation is positive, Federico Ferrer, deputy director at the Treasury for foreign financing told RFTV in Tokyo.
To meet the threshold set up for participation in the common currency, Spain's consumer inflation rate must not exceed 1.5 points above the average of the three lowest rates in Europe.
"(I believe that level) is 2.7 percent while Spain is at 3.6 percent. This is overall, but the underlying is 3.4 percent and the trend is very, very good," Ferrer said.
